note: Comment Notify's global behaviour is entirely in the config object comment_notify.settings (bundle_types = array of entity--bundle--field ids that have the subscribe checkbox; available_alerts = {1: all comments, 2: replies to mine}; enable_default.watcher / enable_default.entity_author; mail_templates.watcher|entity_author.<entity_type>.subject|body). Settings UI at /admin/config/people/comment_notify (route comment_notify.settings, permission 'administer comment notify'). Per-comment subscriptions live in the comment_notify DB table; per-user defaults in user.data via the comment_notify.user_settings service. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real comment_notify.settings config object. Baseline (shipped defaults): bundle_types = ['node--article--comment'], enable_default = {watcher: 'none', entity_author: false}, available_alerts = {1: true, 2: true}.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with comment_notify enabled, where do I configure it, and how do I turn comment notifications on for a particular comment field/content type?
evals.expected_output: Configure it at /admin/config/people/comment_notify (route comment_notify.settings). A comment field is enabled by adding its entity--bundle--field identifier (e.g. node--article--comment) to comment_notify.settings:bundle_types; the subscribe checkbox only appears on comment forms for bundles listed there.

evals.prompt: What subscription options can comment_notify offer a commenter, and which config key controls which of them are available?
evals.expected_output: Two modes: 'All comments' (COMMENT_NOTIFY_ENTITY = 1) and 'Replies to my comment' (COMMENT_NOTIFY_COMMENT = 2). Which are offered is controlled by comment_notify.settings:available_alerts, a map {1: bool, 2: bool}; at least one must stay enabled.

evals.prompt: Where does comment_notify store (a) an individual commenter's subscription to a thread and (b) a user's default notification preference? Is there an unsubscribe mechanism?
evals.expected_output: Per-comment subscriptions are stored in the dedicated comment_notify database table (with an unsubscribe hash and sent flag); per-user default preferences are stored in user.data under the comment_notify module key (via the comment_notify.user_settings service). Each notification email includes an unsubscribe/disable link (routes comment_notify.disable/{hash} and comment_notify.unsubscribe).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, does comment_notify subscribe content authors to follow-up notifications on their own content by default? Inspect the live configuration and answer, naming the config key.
evals.expected_output: Yes. comment_notify.settings:enable_default.entity_author is TRUE on this site, so authors are subscribed to comments on their own content by default.

evals.prompt: Which comment fields / content-type comment fields currently have comment_notify enabled on this site? Inspect the live configuration and list them.
evals.expected_output: comment_notify.settings:bundle_types currently contains node--article--comment and node--page--comment, so notifications are enabled for the Article and Page comment fields.

evals.prompt: Using comment_notify, enable comment notifications for the Page content type's comment field (identifier node--page--comment) on this site, in addition to whatever is already enabled. Apply the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: Add 'node--page--comment' to comment_notify.settings:bundle_types (e.g. drush cget the array, append, drush cset; or edit at /admin/config/people/comment_notify). Afterwards bundle_types contains node--page--comment.

evals.prompt: I want authors on my site to automatically get an email when someone comments on something they wrote, without each author having to opt in. Configure comment_notify so that this is the default, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set comment_notify.settings:enable_default.entity_author to TRUE (drush cset comment_notify.settings enable_default.entity_author 1, or tick 'Subscribe users to their entity follow-up notification emails by default' on the settings form). Then entity authors are subscribed by default.
